releaseNotes: Moves the open-locker UI refresh to the proven native mutation acknowledgement boundary after v76 showed no live-hook refresh. On added-awaiting-save or removed-awaiting-save, v77 refreshes the uniquely matched W_InventoryGrid once through D_UpdateInventory_Event. The v75 saved-change fallback remains intact. Update both PCs and repeat the sequential one-Wire test with both locker UIs left open.
